Test Scenario: Verify automatic status update when blog is published and tracked through GC
Test Case Title: Auto mark blog as Used after successful GC-tracked publication
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with publishing role
2. Blog exists in unused repository
3. External website is connected to GC for publishing
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository
2. Select an unused blog
3. Click Publish via GC
4. Select a GC-connected website
5. Complete the publication flow
6. Observe blog status after successful publication
Expected Result: Blog status is automatically updated to Used without any manual action required
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC1: When a blog is successfully published and tracked through GC its status is automatically updated to Used

Test Scenario: Verify automatic status update when blog is published and tracked through GC
Test Case Title: Auto-remove blog from unused repository after GC-tracked publication
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with publishing role
2. Blog exists in unused repository
3. External website is connected to GC
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository > Unused Blogs list
2. Note the blog count
3. Publish a blog via GC to a connected website
4. Wait for publication confirmation
5. Return to Unused Blogs list
6. Verify the published blog is no longer listed
Expected Result: Published blog is removed from the unused repository list and count decreases by 1
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC2: A blog successfully tracked through GC is automatically removed from the unused repository list

Test Scenario: Verify automatic status update when blog is published and tracked through GC
Test Case Title: Verify Mark as Used option is NOT shown for GC-tracked publications
Preconditions:
1. Blog has been published and tracked through GC
2. Blog status is Used
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository
2. Locate the blog that was published via GC
3. Open the blog action menu or detail view
4. Check for presence of Mark as Used option
Expected Result: Mark as Used option is not visible or is disabled for blogs already tracked by GC
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: The manual Mark as Used option is available only for publications completed outside GC or for publications that GC could not track

Test Scenario: Verify manual Mark as Used for blogs published outside GC
Test Case Title: Manual Mark as Used available for blog downloaded and published outside GC
Preconditions:
1. User has publishing role
2. Blog was downloaded from GC
3. Blog was published on a non-GC-connected website
4. Blog still shows as unused in GC
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository > Unused Blogs
2. Locate the downloaded blog
3. Open the blog action menu
4. Verify Mark as Used option is present
5. Click Mark as Used
6. Select the customer website where it was published
7. Confirm the action
Expected Result: Mark as Used option is available; blog status updates to Used and is removed from unused list
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: The manual Mark as Used option is available only for publications completed outside GC or for publications that GC could not track

Test Scenario: Verify manual Mark as Used for blogs published outside GC
Test Case Title: User can map blog to customer website during manual Mark as Used
Preconditions:
1. Blog was published outside GC
2. Blog is in unused state in GC
Test Steps:
1. Click Mark as Used on the unused blog
2. In the dialog/form that appears verify a website mapping field is present
3. Select or enter the customer website URL where the blog was published
4. Submit the form
Expected Result: Blog is marked as Used and mapped to the specified customer website; mapping is saved and visible in blog details
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual Mark as Used option available for outside-GC publications; AC6: Updated status reflected in repository and publishing counts

Test Scenario: Verify manual Mark as Used for blogs published outside GC
Test Case Title: Repository and publishing counts update after manual Mark as Used
Preconditions:
1. Blog is in unused state
2. User has publishing role
Test Steps:
1. Note current unused blog count and publishing count
2. Manually mark a blog as Used
3. Map it to a customer website
4. Confirm the action
5. Check unused blog count
6. Check publishing count
Expected Result: Unused blog count decreases by 1; publishing count increases by 1; changes are reflected immediately in the dashboard
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC6: The updated status is reflected in repository and publishing counts

Test Scenario: Verify audit trail recording for manual Mark as Used action
Test Case Title: Manual Mark as Used action is recorded in audit trail
Preconditions:
1. User is logged in with publishing role
2. Blog is in unused state
Test Steps:
1. Manually mark a blog as Used and map to a website
2. Navigate to Audit Trail / Activity Log
3. Search or filter by the blog name or action type
4. Locate the audit entry for the Mark as Used action
Expected Result: Audit trail contains an entry with: user who performed the action, timestamp, blog name, action type (Mark as Used), and mapped website
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC5: The manual action is recorded in the audit trail

Test Scenario: Verify audit trail recording for manual Mark as Used action
Test Case Title: Audit trail entry contains correct user and timestamp
Preconditions:
1. User A is logged in
2. Blog is in unused state
Test Steps:
1. Log in as User A
2. Manually mark a blog as Used
3. Navigate to Audit Trail
4. Locate the entry for the action
Expected Result: Audit entry shows the correct username (User A) and an accurate timestamp matching the time of the action
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC5: The manual action is recorded in the audit trail

Test Scenario: Verify prevention of duplicate manual marking when GC publication record exists
Test Case Title: Cannot manually mark as Used if GC publication record already exists
Preconditions:
1. Blog has an existing successful GC publication record
2. Blog status is Used (auto-tracked)
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository
2. Locate a blog that was already published and tracked via GC
3. Attempt to access Mark as Used option
4. Try to submit the manual marking
Expected Result: System prevents the action; an error or informational message is displayed stating the blog already has a GC publication record; status remains unchanged
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC4: If a successful GC publication record already exists the same blog cannot be manually marked as Used again

Test Scenario: Verify prevention of duplicate manual marking when GC publication record exists
Test Case Title: Error message shown when attempting duplicate manual Mark as Used
Preconditions: 1. Blog already has a GC-tracked Used status
Test Steps:
1. Attempt to manually mark the blog as Used via any available UI path
2. Observe the system response
Expected Result: A clear error or warning message is displayed (e.g. This blog has already been published and tracked through GC. Manual marking is not allowed.); no duplicate record is created
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC4: If a successful GC publication record already exists the same blog cannot be manually marked as Used again

Test Scenario: Verify Mark as Used is unavailable for blogs not downloaded outside GC
Test Case Title: Mark as Used not available for blogs never downloaded from GC
Preconditions:
1. Blog exists in repository
2. Blog has never been downloaded or published
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository
2. Select a blog that has never been downloaded
3. Open the action menu
4. Check for Mark as Used option
Expected Result: Mark as Used option is not available for blogs that have no download history outside GC
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual Mark as Used option is available only for outside-GC or untracked publications

Test Scenario: Verify Mark as Used is unavailable for blogs not downloaded outside GC
Test Case Title: Mark as Used not available for blogs already in Used status
Preconditions: 1. Blog is already in Used status (any source)
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Blog Repository
2. Locate a blog with Used status
3. Open the action menu
4. Check for Mark as Used option
Expected Result: Mark as Used option is not available or is disabled for blogs already in Used status
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3 and AC4

Test Scenario: Verify mandatory website mapping during manual Mark as Used
Test Case Title: Cannot submit Mark as Used without selecting a customer website
Preconditions:
1. Blog is in unused state
2. Mark as Used dialog is open
Test Steps:
1. Open Mark as Used dialog for an unused blog
2. Leave the customer website field empty
3. Click Confirm or Submit
Expected Result: System displays a validation error (e.g. Please select or enter the customer website); form is not submitted; blog status remains unchanged
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual Mark as Used requires mapping to relevant customer website

Test Scenario: Verify mandatory website mapping during manual Mark as Used
Test Case Title: Cannot submit Mark as Used with invalid website URL
Preconditions:
1. Blog is in unused state
2. Mark as Used dialog is open
Test Steps:
1. Open Mark as Used dialog
2. Enter an invalid or malformed URL in the website field (e.g. notawebsite or http://)
3. Click Confirm or Submit
Expected Result: System displays a validation error for invalid URL format; form is not submitted
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual Mark as Used requires mapping to relevant customer website

Test Scenario: Verify role-based access for Mark as Used action
Test Case Title: Publishing user can perform manual Mark as Used
Preconditions:
1. User has publishing role
2. Blog is in unused state and eligible for manual marking
Test Steps:
1. Log in as a user with publishing role
2. Navigate to unused blog
3. Attempt to Mark as Used and map to website
Expected Result: Action is allowed; blog is marked as Used successfully
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual Mark as Used available for eligible publications

Test Scenario: Verify role-based access for Mark as Used action
Test Case Title: Non-publishing user cannot perform manual Mark as Used
Preconditions:
1. User has read-only or non-publishing role
2. Blog is in unused state
Test Steps:
1. Log in as a user without publishing role
2. Navigate to unused blog
3. Check for Mark as Used option
Expected Result: Mark as Used option is not visible or is disabled for non-publishing users; action cannot be performed
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3

Test Scenario: Verify GC auto-tracking does not trigger for non-connected websites
Test Case Title: Blog published to non-GC-connected website remains unused until manually marked
Preconditions:
1. Blog is in unused state
2. Target website is NOT connected to GC
Test Steps:
1. Download the blog from GC
2. Manually publish it on a non-GC-connected website
3. Return to GC and check blog status
Expected Result: Blog status remains Unused in GC; no automatic update occurs; manual Mark as Used option is available
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual marking required when GC cannot track publication

Test Scenario: Verify GC auto-tracking does not trigger for non-connected websites
Test Case Title: GC auto-tracks and marks Used only for connected website publications
Preconditions:
1. Blog is in unused state
2. Target website IS connected to GC
Test Steps:
1. Publish blog via GC to a connected website
2. Verify GC receives publication confirmation
3. Check blog status in repository
Expected Result: Blog is automatically marked as Used; removed from unused list; no manual action needed
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC1 and AC2

Test Scenario: Verify system behavior when GC fails to capture publication status
Test Case Title: Mark as Used available when GC publication tracking fails
Preconditions:
1. Blog was published via GC but tracking failed (e.g. network error or webhook failure)
2. Blog still shows as unused
Test Steps:
1. Identify a blog where GC publication tracking failed
2. Navigate to the blog in repository
3. Check for Mark as Used option
Expected Result: Mark as Used option is available as a fallback; user can manually update the status and map to the website
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC3: Manual marking required when GC is unable to capture publication status

Test Scenario: Verify system behavior when GC fails to capture publication status
Test Case Title: Audit trail distinguishes between auto-tracked and manually marked Used status
Preconditions:
1. One blog was auto-tracked by GC
2. Another blog was manually marked as Used
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Audit Trail
2. Compare entries for auto-tracked vs manually marked blogs
Expected Result: Audit entries clearly indicate the source of the Used status: System (auto-tracked) vs User (manual); timestamps and user details are accurate for manual entries
Acceptance Criteria Mapped: AC5: The manual action is recorded in the audit trail
